part.text:
All tests pass. The fix is a one-line change in `lucene/facet/src/java/org/apache/lucene/facet/DrillSidewaysScorer.java:182`: when positioning scorers before scoring, advance `baseApproximation` instead of `baseIterator`. This avoids an initial call to `TwoPhaseIterator.matches()` (via the full iterator) followed by a second `matches()` call during collection without repositioning — the documented at-most-once contract was violated, corrupting postings state in `ExactPhraseMatcher` and causing missed documents for `PhraseQuery` components in `DrillDownQuery`.

Validation:
- `testDrillSidewaysSearchUseCorrectIterator` (reproducer for this issue) passes
- Full `TestDrillSideways` + `TestParallelDrillSideways` suites: 22/22 pass
